description: This is a Python script for generating and inserting CAMEO tags into firmware images used in D-Link DGS-1210 switches. It manipulates uImage headers and root filesystem images to embed specific tags and checksums for bootloader verification.

methods.name: read_buffer
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the uImage file at a given offset.

methods.name: write_buffer
methods.description: Writes a buffer to the uImage file at a specified position.

methods.name: camesum
methods.description: Calculates a 4-byte checksum (sum of bytes) in big-endian format.

methods.name: invertcrc
methods.description: Calculates an inverted CRC32 checksum in little-endian format.

methods.name: checksum_header
methods.description: Modifies the uImage header buffer to embed CAMEO tags and checksums, ensuring header integrity.
